paragraphs: Gamliel: Abba Elazar was his son (see above, Gamla). Issi ben Gamliel (see above, Issi ben Akiva); Rabbi Yishmael ben Gamliel. [Glosses: Gamliel. In Avodah Zarah 21b, Tosafot, s.v. “Mai …”: “For Gamliel of Yavneh is the grandfather of Gamliel.” R.Sh.A. deletes the word “father” [אבי] but did not correct the word “Gamliel,” for he was the father of Rabbi Shimon.]
